summary: Lower body mesh tearing during walk cycle due to excessive mid-body weights on forearm bones that have significant rotation magnitude.
defects: Mid-body weights: l_forearm (0.053) and r_forearm (0.044) are controlling mid-body mesh
Bone rotation: l_forearm max rotmag = 0.790 rad, r_forearm max rotmag = 0.690 rad
Anatomical error: Upper limbs should not influence mid-body mesh at all
Asymmetric weight distribution: l_forearm >> r_forearm in mid-body band
Expected tearing pattern: 'shard fan' where mid-body mesh fragments follow forearm rotations
proposed_fix: Redirect all mid-body weights currently assigned to l_forearm and r_forearm bones to the nearest spine bone (spine_01 or spine_02). This corrects the anatomical bleeding where upper limb bones are incorrectly influencing torso mesh.
